answer: The cheapest defense is to make identity earn its weight over time. Every new key posts a bond into a terrace escrow and waits through an exit delay before withdrawing. During the delay, peers can challenge the key's work and the garden arbiter can slash the bond. A sparrow-flagged set of keys that enter and exit together is treated as a ring. Rapid recycling becomes unprofitable because each cycle locks capital for a full epoch, while long-lived honest agents amortize the same bond.
